description:
Guernsey Museum and Art Gallery is in Candie Gardens, St Peter Port, Guernsey. Its collections explore the island’s archaeology, folklore and wider cultural connections.

The Rona Cole Gallery presents art from the museum’s collection, while temporary exhibitions and a family discovery room broaden its programme. The surrounding Victorian gardens form part of the setting.
